title: hippochaete hyemalis var. jesupii
intro: Hippochaete hyemalis var. jesupii, commonly known as Jesup's wintergreen, is a plant species within the gentian family, native to North America. Jesup's wintergreen has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including the potential to aid in reducing inflammation and pain. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties, which are thought to be due to the presence of bioactive constituents such as methyl salicylate and salicylic acid. However, further research is required to fully understand the bioactive constituents and therapeutic actions of Jesup's wintergreen.
